name: addBookCopy
intent: Add a new physical copy to the selected book.
pre: A book with the supplied callNo exists.
The selected book has no copy with the supplied barcode.
post: Set the new copy's barcode to barcode.
Set the new copy's status to AVAILABLE.
Set the new copy's location to location.
Mark the new copy as not reserved.
Add the new copy to the selected book's copies.
Link the new copy to the selected book.
Increase the book's copy count by one relative to its value before this operation.
Store the new copy among the system's book copies.
difficulty_basis: Book-scoped duplicate guard, new copy, bidirectional association and counter increment.
scenarios: Stored copy fields, book link, count increment and true checked; book.Copys membership not directly asserted.
Second copy with same barcode for same book is rejected; setup's first success indirectly depends on adding to book copies.
effects_audit: Uniqueness scope is only selected book.Copys, not all copies globally. No automatic loan/reservation-record initialization inferred.
